answer: A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ledge counter is kept in falcon and sable shows each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1294 identities would post 4174 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
